name: @mionjs/uws
description: Loader for the uWebSockets.js prebuilt native binaries. Resolves the addon for the host platform; the binaries ride as per-platform optional dependencies (npm mirror of uNetworking/uWebSockets.js). Ships zero runtime dependencies.
author: ma jerez
comment:exports: No separate CJS build: every supported Node (>= 22, the uWS floor) can require() an ES module without top-level await, so the `default` condition serves CJS consumers of @mionjs/platform-uws's require entry too.
comment:engines: Mirrors the Node majors the pinned uWebSockets.js tag ships ABIs for (raw V8 addon, no ABI stability), so a mismatch warns at install time instead of crashing at require time.
comment:uwsTag: The pinned uNetworking/uWebSockets.js release tag the binaries come from. Pure metadata (NOT this package's semver — that is the mion lockstep); scripts/lib/fetch-uws.mjs downloads and sha256-verifies against uws-checksums.json, and scripts/release/build-uws-binaries.mjs stages the per-platform payload packages from the same tag.
comment:optionalDependencies: Intentionally EMPTY in source — the dev tree resolves the on-demand-fetched binary in .uws-cache/ (pnpm miondevx core build uws). The full per-platform set (@mionjs/uws-<os>-<arch>, pinned exact-equal to this package's version) is injected into the PUBLISHED tarball only, by scripts/release/build-uws-binaries.mjs.
